scope: External-only reselection of inherited prediction and semi-Markov blocks using label-free challenge input distribution for stress design, not parameter scoring.

graded_missing_after_repair.purpose: Design external missingness stress without choosing model values from challenge output.

prediction.score: correct observed external ball positions within 1.5 m minus twice wrong predicted positions outside that radius; abstention zero, average per masked frame across three gap lengths

decoder.selection_interpretation: The original decoder vector also wins an external-only 25-fps comparison under fixed guard thresholds; this is new evidence, not proof the historical match-proxy origin never occurred.

remaining_blocks.restart_localization_and_fallback_timing: External provider event times do not reproduce the challenge Smart Tagging phase-start/Team semantics; using the candidate's offset to synthesize its own tags is circular.
remaining_blocks.restart_ownership: Needs independently tagged, rights-cleared external input or explicit vendor semantics before strict-workflow provenance can be certified.
remaining_blocks.other_inherited_keys: All 44 remain unchanged from the legacy default and have not each been separately tuned for this candidate.

decision: Keep the versioned exit bracket as the primary working candidate and original default as fallback; do not promote default merely because one inherited block can be externally reselected. Restart/tag provenance remains unresolved.
limitations: Metrica Game 1 is development, Games 2-3 were already inspected; ball coordinates are provider tracking, not human physical-ball truth.
No fully independent real Smart Tagging source is available in the DFL no-tag validation.
No parameter was chosen by viewing the challenge output against video, using its public possession slice, or reading protected ground truth.
